data.narrative:
44.01 is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $37M to date. The relevant comp universe comprises one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, though none exhibit sufficient similarity in stage and valuation tier to support a robust peer-median approach.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation lever. Using the $37M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $74M. A peer-median cross-check was not viable due to insufficient clustering within narrow stage and tier filters across the Climate & Energy sector—while nine same-sector comps exist, none met the threshold of three or more comparable datapoints when filtered by adjacent stage or valuation similarity. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce material distortion.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $85M (high), with a median estimate of $74M. This reflects uncertainty inherent in single-method triangulation and the absence of direct peer-level validation. Key sensitivities include the robustness of the 2.0x multiplier for Series A climate-tech specifically and the competitive tightness of the company's position within a fragmented sector. More narrow peer data at series B and later stages would strengthen conviction.
